completeness.why: Four sites now pass their raw value (missing, number or range) to the existing getScheduledAmount, which decides all three cases; schedule-template.ts runSchedule keeps its own `isbetween ? Math.round(num1 + num2) / 2 : value` copy untouched, which preserves its different rounding but leaves it outside the shared definition instead of carrying it as an explicit rounding argument.

interface.why: Reuses the existing getScheduledAmount(amount, inverse) without speculative options and documents it, but the template's halve-the-rounded-sum inconsistency is preserved only by leaving that site alone rather than being made explicit as a parameter.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline ternaries are removed in favour of the shared helper; the remaining template copy in server/budget/schedule-template.ts is an untouched pre-existing copy, not a reshaped one.
